faq.q1: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.a1: Yes, at any time. The change takes effect at the start of the next billing month.
faq.a2: No. You can cancel at any time without penalties.
faq.q3: What's the difference between AI analysis and growth tracking?
faq.a3: Growth tracking is a plant history with photos over time. AI analysis is a one-time image scan with a detailed report and suggested tasks.
faq.a4: For Professional users, each pack adds 10 extra gardens to the account. There's no limit on the number of packs.
faq.q5: Does the annual subscription include a discount?
faq.a5: Yes — annual payment saves about two months compared to paying monthly.
